description: This script manages and detects iOS development teams and signing configurations, integrating with Xcode preferences, legacy defaults, provisioning profiles, and keychain automations.

methods.name: detect_python
methods.description: Detects an available Python interpreter from a list of candidates.

methods.name: append_team
methods.description: Adds a team ID, free status, and name to the respective arrays if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_preferences
methods.description: Loads teams from Xcode preferences plist file, parsing JSON with Python.

methods.name: load_teams_from_legacy_defaults_key
methods.description: Loads team IDs from legacy defaults.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_managed_profiles
methods.description: Loads team IDs from provisioning profiles stored in user profiles, parsing plist data.

methods.name: has_xcode_account
methods.description: Checks if an Xcode account is configured by reading its plist.
